assessment_summary.cou_name: Use CFD to compare Rev B manifold variants and size the fan with margin (not for final spec)

evidence_keywords: Mesh refinement: Poly-hexcore
Coarse: 3.1M cells; Medium: 6.4M; Fine: 13.2M.
Δp between medium and fine changed by 2.6% at 300 CFM
extrapolated asymptotic ratio ~1.3
Residuals < 1e-5 for all equations
mass imbalance < 0.2%
monitor points flat for last 1,500 iterations
Steady RANS with SST (k-ω)
Second-order spatial schemes, coupled pressure-velocity.
Flow is incompressible (Ma < 0.1) and isothermal.
Switching to realizable k-ε reduces Δp by ~2.4%
equivalent sand roughness ks = 12 μm
Inlet turbulence intensity 5%, length scale 0.02 m.
Wall roughness sensitivity run from ks = 6–24 μm
Inlet turbulence intensity from 1% to 10% moves Δp by < 1.2%.
ASHRAE 51 rig, 25 °C air
At 300 CFM/branch
Instrumentation uncertainty reported by the lab: ±3% on Δp.
Rev A geometry replicated following the same setup
neoprene gaskets installed
gasket lip not in the model
No leakage paths included.
Test Δp = 230 Pa; model (Rev A geometry replicated following the same setup) = 219 Pa (−4.8%).
At 200 and 400 CFM, Δp errors were −7.0% and −2.1%
Slope of the resistance curve matches the lab within ~2%.
area-averaged magnitude off by 3.5%
